system.description:
Your personality causes all to pay heed and bow before you. None can raise sword in challenge to you or act to incur your ire. Expend a Willpower Trait; for the duration of the scene, you are under the effects of Majesty (indicated by holding your arms out from your sides, or with a special ribbon or card). While in effect, none may insult or attack you as long as they are within 10 feet of you and can see you.

Subjects must expend a Willpower Trait and win a Social Challenge against you to breach your aura of command and attack you; failing, they may spend another Willpower Trait for a retest, but those who fail may not try again for the duration of the scene. You may use Mental and Social Disciplines while using Majesty, but any overt attack or hostile action causes the effect to fade, possibly leaving you surrounded by enraged and shocked subjects.
